title: I Tried Day Trading for 30 Days (Here's What Happened)
summary: Thirty-day forex day-trading challenge on a demo account ending slightly up; finds patience, loss-chasing and small sample size dominate the outcome.

assertions.quote: according to the internet 95% of day Traders never make any money
when studying it's very easy to see where I could have entered a trade to make money
I was taking worse and worse setups because I just wanted to make the money back
this entire month could have just been purely luck and I won't know that until I get to that three-digit Mark
which is called back testing which isn't as difficult as a live market but it's good for practice

verdicts.note: Look-ahead bias, overfitting and the absence of execution costs and emotion make backtests systematically optimistic.

assertions.quote: you can learn a lot of skills by day trading every single day for a month

verdicts.note: Whether the skills are worth the time is a matter of judgement.

assertions.quote: can you get rich in a month with day trading no you won't be able to

verdicts.note: Even the best documented traders compound slowly; month-level outcomes for beginners are dominated by noise and losses.
Only 15.5% of those who day traded 2-50 days ended with any positive net profit, and even the best long-run trader averaged US$310 a day; wealth after one month is not measured directly.
